cases.prompt: Assess the explicit exported configuration and validation requirements using current source and observed tests, without inventing installation or release requirements.

files.TASK.md:
R1: Export timeoutMs as at least 1000.
R2: Accept only finite positive budgets.
files.feature.mjs:
export const timeoutMs = 1000;
export function acceptBudget(value) { return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0; }
files.test.mjs: import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { timeoutMs, acceptBudget } from './feature.mjs'; assert.ok(timeoutMs >= 1000); for (const value of [0,-1,NaN,Infinity]) assert.equal(acceptBudget(value),false); assert.equal(acceptBudget(1),true);
